reviewer: Codex source review under maintainer instruction; not a human sign-off
review_method: Public repository opened in Codex web; pinned README, implementation and LICENSE retrieved from public raw URLs and inspected. No upstream code executed.
identity_check: Exact repository owner/name checked; same-name projects and legacy aliases not merged by name.
role_findings_zh: 提示与仓库上下文进入 Jev 的批量判断，路由代码将任务要求映射到模型和推理档位；缓存与启发式路径可跳过 Jev 请求。
role_findings_en: Jev receives a prompt and repository context for batched judgments. Routing code maps task demands to model and effort; caches and heuristics can bypass Jev calls.
limitations_zh: 作者的成本与自动切换说法未在本库复测。缺 Key 时会启发式回退，这不是 Jev 运行证据。项目明确限于 CLI，不适用于桌面 App。
limitations_en: Cost and automatic switching claims were not tested here. Keyless heuristic fallback is not evidence of a Jev run. The project explicitly targets CLI, not the desktop App.

sources.inspected_scope: Project overview, Jev role, installation entry and limitations; full file captured, not every unrelated feature audited.
Targeted API client, provider, decision or routing symbols; not an exhaustive code/security audit.
License text and attribution boundary; not a legal opinion.
